styles.title: Styles
styles.hint: Switch a style off and it is left out of the style picker for everyone, admins included. Tape already up in it stays as it is.

holders.title: Posts and cones
holders.hint: Police pick from these with H while placing. Switch one off and it can no longer be put up; ones already standing stay, and tape can still be tied to them.
holders.toast_all_on: All posts and cones are available

settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: These change the config while the server runs, for everyone at once, and are kept in data/settings.json. Set one back to what the config says and it is no longer kept.

Tear_Enabled.label: Tape can break
Tear_Enabled.hint: Vehicles driving through it and people pushing hard snap it, for everyone. Off: it slips off whatever pushes it and springs back into line.

Tear_People.label: People can break tape
Tear_People.hint: Someone pushing through tape on foot snaps it. Off: tape holds people back instead.

Physics_Enabled.label: Tape gives way
Physics_Enabled.hint: Tape bows round people and vehicles pushing into it. Off: tape never moves (no pushing, no tearing); wind still sways it.

Wind_Enabled.label: Wind
Wind_Enabled.hint: Tape sways and twists in the game's wind.

Holders_Knock.label: Posts and cones can be knocked over
Holders_Knock.hint: One knocked over goes down for everybody, and its tape with it.

Holders_Vehicles.label: Vehicles knock them over
Holders_Vehicles.hint: A vehicle driving into one knocks it over and sends it along the road.

Holders_Kick.label: Kicks knock them over
Holders_Kick.hint: A kick or a punch right at one knocks it over.

Holders_Run.label: Running into them knocks them over
Holders_Run.hint: Walking into one only bumps against it.

Holders_StandUp.label: They can be stood back up
Holders_StandUp.hint: Anyone allowed to use tape can stand a knocked-over post or cone back up.

Placement_Posts.label: Posts and cones on open ground
Placement_Posts.hint: Aiming at open ground stands a post or cone there to tie to. Off: tape only ties to walls, poles and trees.

Placement_Chain.label: Keep going after tying off
Placement_Chain.hint: The next stretch starts where the last one ended, until Done.

Access_OthersTapes.label: Take down anyone's tape
Access_OthersTapes.hint: Off: players take down only tape they put up themselves (admins any).

Item_Enabled.label: Needs a roll of police tape
Item_Enabled.hint: Placing tape needs the tape item in the inventory.

Item_Consume.label: Uses up a roll per stretch
Item_Consume.hint: One roll is taken for every stretch of tape put up.

Item_Refund.label: Gives the roll back
Item_Refund.hint: With rolls used up: taking down your own tape gives the roll back.

Persist.label: Tape survives restarts
Persist.hint: Tape is kept in data/tapes.json and comes back after a restart. Off: none does, and the file is emptied at once.

PersistChoice.label: Players choose per tape
PersistChoice.hint: While placing (F) and in a tape's popup, players say whether that tape is kept. Off: all tape is kept.
